description: Voice for OpenCode: dictate prompts (live or batch, Mac or phone mic) with whisper, clean them up with an LLM, fix them by re-speaking, and hear replies in natural Vietnamese and English with VieNeu-TTS (Piper fallback).

detail.description_zh: OpenCode 的语音转文本和文本转语音。使用 whisper-cpp 录制语音提示，通过 Piper TTS 听取响应，通过任何与 OpenAI 兼容的端点进行 LLM 标准化。
